name: LexonAds: Free Ad Network – Boost Traffic & Get More Visitors
author: bundgaard

sections.description:
LexonAds is a powerful, automated ad exchange network designed to help WordPress site owners get more traffic without a marketing budget.

By installing this plugin, your website joins a collaborative network. Your site displays a small, neat ad bar, and in return, your website is promoted across thousands of other sites in the LexonAds network.

Interested in these services instead?

Martins Free Link Building
Free Link-in-bio Page That Pays You

Why use LexonAds?

  • Automated Traffic: No need to set up complex campaigns.
  • Smart Keyword Matching: Our intelligent crawler identifies your best keywords to show your ads to the right audience.
  • Boost Visibility: Perfect for new blogs, affiliate sites, and WooCommerce stores.
  • Beautiful Dashboard: Track your ad impressions and visitor growth directly in WordPress.

3rd Party Service Notice

This plugin relies on the free 3rd party service “LexonAds by Martin’s Tools” (Software as a Service) to manage the ad network and provide your statistics.

By using this plugin, some of your URLs are sent to LexonAds to create your ad campaigns and statistics dashboard.
* Service Home: https://lexonads.com
* Terms of Service: https://lexonads.com/terms.html
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for LexonAds.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to the new ‘LexonAds’ menu to see your traffic stats.
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes! It is a community-driven exchange. You earn credits by showing ads, which are then used to promote your own site.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The ad bar is optimized for performance and loads asynchronously to ensure your site remains fast.

Can I filter the content?

Yes. We have a strict policy. Offensive content is automatically detected and moved to a separate, isolated network.
